posts.title: The Sales Model Omits Skills to Facilitate the Buy Side Decision Journey, by Sharon-Drew Morgen
posts.description: At what point in a problem-solving situation do you decide to bring in an external solution (buy something)? Have you tried all possible fixes? Do you know the risks of bringing in something new? Do the folks involved agree, or is the risk too great to consider?
